changelog: Fixed ERROR_CODE_DECODING_FAILED on Android tablets, phones, and TVs for Dolby E-AC3 / AC3 / DTS / Dual Audio movies: switched Media3 to EXTENSION_RENDERER_MODE_PREFER (always using bundled Jellyfin FFmpeg Audio Decoder first instead of broken OEM tablet codecs) and added automatic mid-stream Software Video Decoder fallback (c2.android / OMX.google) that resumes at the exact second.
Added proper Media AudioAttributes + headphone unplug auto-pause, anti-time-jump clock watchdog, lazy LoudnessEnhancer, broken external-subtitle auto-recovery, and safe # and % URL encoding.

Universal APK supporting Android Phones, Tablets, and Android TV / Google TV (LEANBACK_LAUNCHER, 640x360 TV banner, glowing D-Pad focus, top navigation bar, TV remote playback controls, and VLC-style 8-mode video size / aspect-ratio fixing).
